entities.name: Suido River
entities.description: A river flowing through southern Madara from the Gitte-Yatay Mountains.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War during which the Suido was dammed.

entities.name: Meteor Hammer
entities.description: Spell that led to the Suido being dammed.
